title: Unforgettable engagement photo shoot in Sitges
text:
We did our first photo shoot in the beautiful city of Sitges to celebrate our engagement, and it was an amazing experience! Esteban and Sushruta were very professional, they guided us at all times, from choosing the outfit to choosing the best places for photos. They made us feel comfortable and safe, and the end result is spectacular. 

Thank you for your professionalism and for guiding us in this session with kindness, without rush and laughter, revealing our best angles. Highly recommended!

title: A magical pre-wedding photoshoot in Sitges
text:

title: Authentic Moments, Timeless Photos
text: I have been living in Barcelona for many years, and every time my family visits, I reconnect with the wonderful community I’ve found here. Esteban is, without a doubt, the most talented photographer I have worked with. He not only provides excellent recommendations but also creates a relaxed and joyful atmosphere, ensuring that everyone feels comfortable during the shoot. His ability to capture authentic moments is truly impressive — and when you finally see the photos, you realize how effortlessly he managed to preserve such special memories.
